# Plot the zoo trajectories from Site A (22008), Site B (20135), Site C (50785), and Site D (84235)

This Rmarkdown plots the infection trajectories for individual frogs exposed in the zoos prior to release in the wild.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(lubridate)
```

# Load Site A and Site B frogs

```{r}
tdat = fread("../../data/lab_data/zoo_exposures_22008_20135_releases.csv")

# Set-up data for plotting
tdat = tdat[, c("time_step"):=as.integer(Date - Date[1]), by=.(Individual_ID)]
tdat$year = year(tdat$Date)

# Relabel sites
tdat$site_id = "Site A"
tdat$treatment = ifelse(tdat$treatment_label_1 == "Control", 'unexposed', 'exposed')

```

Tyndall frogs went to both Site A and Site B.  Let's identify these via pit tags

```{r}
t_frogs = fread("../../data/field_data/22008/reintroductions_22008_mrmr.csv")
t_pit = t_frogs$pit_tag_id

r_frogs = fread("../../data/field_data/20135/reintroductions_20135_mrmr.csv")
r_pit = r_frogs$pit_tag_id

# Label Tyndall and Ranger Frogs
tdat$site_id[tdat$Pit_Tag %in% t_pit] = "Site A"
tdat$site_id[tdat$Pit_Tag %in% r_pit] = "Site B"

# Specify approximate antifungal date
afd1 = mdy("05/27/2016")

# Loop through individuals and append if necessary
unq_ids = tdat$Individual_ID
all_ids = list()
count = 1
for(tid in unq_ids){
  uid_dat = tdat[Individual_ID == tid][, .(Individual_ID, ZE_calculated, year, Date, treatment, site_id, Pit_Tag)][order(Date)]
  
  # Set the zeros pre-exposure
  if(uid_dat$Date[1] == ymd("2016-05-12") | uid_dat$Date[1] == ymd("2016-05-11")){
    new_dat = uid_dat[1, ]
    new_dat$Date = new_dat$Date - 8
    new_dat$ZE_calculated = 0
    uid_dat = rbind(new_dat, uid_dat)
  }
  
  if(uid_dat$Date[1] == ymd("2017-02-27")){
    new_dat = uid_dat[1, ]
    new_dat$Date = new_dat$Date - 8
    new_dat$ZE_calculated = 0
    uid_dat = rbind(new_dat, uid_dat)
  }
  
  # Remove post-antifungal data
  if(uid_dat$year[1] == 2016){
    #uid_dat = uid_dat[Date < mdy("05/27/2016")]
    uid_dat$af_date = mdy("05/23/2016")
    uid_dat = uid_dat[year == 2016]
  }

  if(any(uid_dat$Date %in% ymd("2017-02-27"))){
    #uid_dat = uid_dat[Date <= mdy("03/20/2017")]
    uid_dat$af_date = mdy("03/20/2017")
  }

  if(any(uid_dat$Date %in% mdy("05/11/2017")) | (any(uid_dat$Date %in% mdy("04/19/2017")))){
    #uid_dat = uid_dat[Date <= mdy("05/11/2017")]
    uid_dat$af_date = mdy("05/11/2017")
  }
  
  all_ids[[count]] = uid_dat
  count = count + 1

}

tdat_append = do.call(rbind, all_ids)
tdat_append = tdat_append[, c("time_step"):=as.integer(Date - Date[1]), by=.(Individual_ID)]
```


```{r}
sample_size_labs = tdat_append[Pit_Tag %in% c(t_pit, r_pit)][,
                              .(count=length(unique(Individual_ID))), 
                                by=.(treatment, year, site_id)][
                                order(site_id, year, treatment)]
sample_size_labs$count_lab = paste0("n = ", sample_size_labs$count)

pab = ggplot(tdat_append[Pit_Tag %in% c(t_pit, r_pit)], aes(x=Date, y=log10(ZE_calculated + 1))) + 
            geom_line(aes(group=Individual_ID, color=Individual_ID)) + 
            geom_point(size=0.5) +
            geom_vline(aes(xintercept=af_date), linetype="dashed") +
            geom_text(data = sample_size_labs,
                      aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = count_lab),
                      inherit.aes = FALSE,
                      hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3) +
            facet_grid(site_id~treatment + year, scales="free_x") + 
            theme_classic() + theme(legend.position = "none", 
                                    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) + 
            ylab("log10(Bd load + 1)") + xlab("Date")

pab
```

```{r}
tdat_append[Pit_Tag %in% c(t_pit, r_pit)][, .(count=length(unique(Individual_ID))), by=.(treatment, year, site_id)][order(site_id, year, treatment)]
```

# Make plots for Site C

```{r}
sitec_dat = fread("../../data/lab_data/zoo_exposures_50785_releases.csv")
sitec_pit = fread("../../data/field_data/50785/reintroductions_50785_mrmr.csv")$pit_tag_id
sitec_dat$year = year(sitec_dat$collect_date)
sitec_dat$site_id = "Site C"
sitec_dat$treatment = sitec_dat$bd_exposure

sample_size_labs = sitec_dat[pit_tag_id %in% c(sitec_pit)][,
                              .(count=length(unique(pit_tag_id))), 
                                by=.(treatment, year, site_id)][
                                order(site_id, year, treatment)]
sample_size_labs$count_lab = paste0("n = ", sample_size_labs$count)


pc = ggplot(sitec_dat[pit_tag_id %in% c(sitec_pit)], aes(x=collect_date, y=log10(bd_load + 1))) + 
              geom_line(aes(group=as.factor(pit_tag_id), color=as.factor(pit_tag_id))) +
              geom_point(size=0.5) +
              geom_text(data = sample_size_labs,
                      aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = count_lab),
                      inherit.aes = FALSE,
                      hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3) +
              geom_vline(aes(xintercept=mdy("06/06/2019")), linetype="dashed") +
              facet_grid(site_id~treatment + year, scales="free_x") +
              theme_classic() + theme(legend.position = "none", 
                                    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) +
              ylab("log10(Bd load + 1)") + xlab("Date")
pc
```
# Make plots for Site D

```{r}
age_data = fread("../../data/lab_data/AGE_experiment_data.csv")
release_metadata = as.data.table(read.csv("../../data/lab_data/zoo_exposures_84235_individual_ids.csv"))[, .(ID, Pit.Tag)]
colnames(release_metadata) = c("ID", "pit_tag_id")

age_data = merge(age_data, release_metadata, by="ID", all.x=TRUE)

sited_frogs = fread("../../data/field_data/84235/reintroductions_84235_mrmr.csv")
sited_pit = sited_frogs$pit_tag_id
sited_pit

age_data_trun = age_data[pit_tag_id %in% sited_pit]
age_data_trun$date = mdy(age_data_trun$date)
age_data_trun$year = year(age_data_trun$date)
age_data_trun$treatment = ifelse(age_data_trun$treatment == 1, "exposed", "unexposed")
age_data_trun$site_id = "Site D"
age_data_trun$capture_state = ifelse(age_data_trun$wild_or_naive == "wild", "Collected as froglet", "Collected as egg")

age_data_trun
```

Merge in the post-anti-fungal data

```{r}
post_af = fread("../../data/lab_data/AGE_experiment_post_treatment.csv")
post_af
post_af_melt = melt(post_af, id.vars = c("id", "pit_tag_id", "group", "treatment_type"), 
                    value.name = 'ave_ZE', 
                    variable.name = "date")
post_af_melt
colnames(post_af_melt) = c('ID', 'pit_tag_id', "wild_or_naive", "treatment", "date", "ave_ZE")
post_af_melt$date = mdy(post_af_melt$date)
post_af_melt = as.data.table(post_af_melt)
post_af_melt = post_af_melt[pit_tag_id %in% sited_pit]


post_af_melt

post_af_melt$wild_or_naive[post_af_melt$wild_or_naive != "wild"] = "naive"
post_af_melt$treatment = ifelse(post_af_melt$treatment == "treatment", "exposed", "unexposed")

age_data_trun = rbind(age_data_trun[, .(ID, pit_tag_id, wild_or_naive, treatment, date, ave_ZE)], post_af_melt)[order(ID, date)]

age_data_trun$capture_state = ifelse(age_data_trun$wild_or_naive == "wild", "Collected as froglet", "Collected as egg")

age_data_trun$site_id = "Site D"
age_data_trun$year = year(age_data_trun$date)
```


```{r}
sample_size_labs = age_data_trun[,
                              .(count=length(unique(pit_tag_id))), 
                                by=.(treatment, year, site_id)][
                                order(site_id, year, treatment)]
sample_size_labs$count_lab = paste0("n = ", sample_size_labs$count)

pd = ggplot(age_data_trun, aes(x=date, y=log10(ave_ZE + 1))) + 
            geom_line(aes(group=as.factor(pit_tag_id), color=as.factor(pit_tag_id), linetype=capture_state)) +
            geom_point(size=0.5) +
            geom_text(data = sample_size_labs,
                      aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = count_lab),
                      inherit.aes = FALSE,
                      hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3) +
            geom_vline(aes(xintercept=mdy("04/28/2015")), linetype="dashed") +
            facet_grid(site_id~treatment + year, scales="free_x") +
            guides(color="none") +
            theme_classic() + theme(legend.position = c(0.8, 0.7), 
                                    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) +
            ylab("log10(Bd load + 1)") + xlab("Date")
pd
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)

# Define custom layout string
layout <- "
  AAAA
  BBCC
"

# Combine using the design
(pab + pc + pd) + plot_layout(design = layout)
ggsave("../../results/zoo_exposure_trajectories.pdf", width=12, height=10)
```
